card.name: Just before vasoconstriction or vasodilation
card.fires_on: The 'aso' or 'vas' piece inside vasoconstriction, vasodilation, vasopressor, and nearby words that lead into them. Also fires on linking words like 'to' or 'coronary' right before a blood-vessel narrowing or widening term.

modes.description: A linking or modifier word that sets up an expected vessel term such as dilation or vasoconstriction.
modes.example: due<< to>> the dilation of arteries passing through deeper parts

card.writes: It pushes toward vessel-related continuations such as vascular, vessels, vas, dilation, and constr.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to talk about blood vessels narrowing or widening.
